name: Cloud-Cricket
journal_prompt: An insect that produces high-frequency, melodic chirps that echo through the thin, cold air of the high altitude routes.
placement_note: Placeable since the sky tiles were painted. The earlier note held this as lore "until a sky mode exists" -- `sky_island` and `sky_underside` are renderable now, so the condition it named is met.
appearance: A lightweight orthopteran of the low-gravity heights, with a translucent pale-cyan exoskeleton, glass-like antennae and a slender, silver-veined abdomen that catches the light of the thin air.
